messages.content_text:
Market open gave us 1H diddy candle while bullish so kept same bullish bias. 
Wasnt gonna take a trade cuz it was too scary.

Saw a retracement into a 15m FVG but was a pretty shallow retracement so wasnt willing on taking a 1min entry.

Waited to see if 5min would give me a confident entry and saw 5m RB + CISD + SMT. 
Used the RB CE as entry as it was same level as 1min CISD. i was too scared to take the 5 min CISD entry.
SL at bottom of RB an TP at ATH. (edited)

messages.author: Chim
messages.content_text:
Bullish because of unfilled gap on 30min and MMBM. We made a 30min RB CE out of the daily OB CE (wanted to see a buy model from the daily OB), also SMT on the 15min with ES. Set the fib on the range. Marked out 3min/1min rb that lined up with golden level. 1:00 opens and we drop into OTE and the rb i had marked. I had a limit on the RB with a 10pt stop. Ticked into the trade. After going into the 3min bearish fvg I set stops below the low we made to only risk 3pts. got mad close to stop. Got greedy and wanted the 30min gap so when we hit 1:00 (original TP), I set my stop to the original tp level to secure the profit. Got wicked out but we are headed towards that unfilled gap after (edited)

messages.content_text:
1H was bullish and waited for a retracement into 13:00 ko + 0.62 FIB
Market consolidated till NY open and swept some liquidity
Tried to enter on the 1min CISD at 9:31 but tradeovate didnt tap my limit order.
Saw a push towards my draw of liquidity and waited for another 1 min retracement
placed limit order at 9:30 ko + 1min 0.5 FIB with SL below previous low as i didnt think it would come all the way back down again. 
TP1 at 18:00 ko and TP2 at 1H asia high. Didnt move SL to BE since there was orange folder at 9:45.
